typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DailyRun as string (),
	Eligibility_FileName as string (),
	EmailRecipientFailure as string (),
	EmailRecipientSuccess as string (),
	Medical_FileName as string (),
	MFIDateDiff as integer (),
	MFIFile as string (),
	MFIRowCount as integer (),
	MFI_Auto_FileName as string (),
	MFI_Auto_File_OutputFolder as string (),
	MFI_Auto_InitialFileName as string (),
	MFI_Dump_FileName as string (),
	Password_DX as string (),
	Pharmacy_FileName as string (),
	Root_Path as string (),
	ServerName_DX as string (),
	Source_PacketSize_DX as integer (),
	UserName_DX as string ()
}

source(output(
		THERAPEUTIC_CLASS as string,
		{PAID DATE} as date,
		NDC as string,
		RECIPIENT_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select CAST(A.MedicaidID as NVARCHAR(14)) as RECIPIENT_ID, 	   CAST(A.NDCCode as NVARCHAR(20)) as NDC, 	   CAST(A.Therapeutic_Class as NVARCHAR(10)) as THERAPEUTIC_CLASS, 	   CAST(A.PaidDate as DATE)  as [PAID DATE] 	 from EXTRACT.KY_Enrollment_MFI_Phramcy_Extract A',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		THERAPEUTIC_CLASS as string,
		PAID_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NDC as string,
		RECIPIENT_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		THERAPEUTIC_CLASS,
		PAID_DATE = {PAID DATE},
		NDC,
		RECIPIENT_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
